notes.title: Guild League Version - New Major Upgrade Release！
notes.content:
Hello honorable commanders,

A major upgrade of Battle Brawlers has been released. New gameplay "Guild League" got online grandly! 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32407525/4c4271b03b6b91e3e93b4c6cecfcada43c1ce634.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32407525/405ff327bbcedc4e41178b2cc791ae7ab251b269.jpg

Monthly Guild League contains 5 periods - Registeration, Preliminary, Semi-Finals, Final Time and Offseason. 

All guilds can register for Guild League. After the Preliminary period, the top 200 guilds are qualified to enter the Semi-Finals. During the cruel battles of Semi-Finals most guilds will get knocked out and only 24 guilds have the honor of entering the Final Time. The last guild standing will be honored with title "The Strongest Guild" of the month and guild members will receive generous awards!

All guilds in ranking list will receive certain awards. Members of top 3 guilds get an extra award "Guild League Frame" which shows the glory of Guild League Winners.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32407525/1a4900daed86e2cc03a53fc7193c8d9684ad3dfe.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32407525/4cacfa718ca5ea57f9262bc94501faf68bf35fc7.png

Double Runestone Awards

 Double Runestone awards in "Daily Checkin"
 Double Runestone awards in "Daily Quests"
 Double Runestone awards in "Limited Quests"
 Double Runestone awards in "Rune Chest"
 Double Runestoneawards in "Daily ictory Chests"


Runes Adjustments

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32407525/dddbb58fc989b71810759fea41182d3be0593e7b.jpg

 Agility: Effect of level 5 Agility changes from increasing hero attack speed by 8% to 10%.   

 Hunger: Effect of level 4/5 Hunger changes from hero skill leech 8%/10% to 10%/14%.

 Mana Blast: Effect of level 2/3/4/5 Mana Blast changes from increasing damage of magic spells bought in battle by 4%/7%/10%/13% to 5%/9%/11%/14%.

Let the flame devour everything!https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32407525/80a1688fade6435291f0749f2ee7037d546fb2b7.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32407525/26737ee54ec189c7e162668b53eb4d2852751810.jpg


3.Maintenance Announcement Optimization
Optimize the UI pop up at maintenance period. Now you can read announcement of update at maintenance.


4.Rank List Optimization
Optimize rank list of ladder tournament. Now you can view players' personal profile and guild information at rank list.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32407525/987516386be41ba71e59285ee85a9caf51b22699.jpg


5.Adjustment on Master Card Championship
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32407525/207d92c209a2f20d96d878bd65b96bb13ed8a9d0.png
To provide better experience of gameplay, we keep up adjusting the mechanics of Master Card Championship:


 1. Limit of rounds changes to 20. 


 2. Take the initial Prophecy (randomly change troops on deck) back.


 3. Take the Defend and Recycle back.


 4. Begin at the 15th round, War Gods of both sides enter status "Exhausting", losing 1% of max HP per second.


 5. Condition of Win: Player whose War God stays alive wins. If both War Gods die at same time, the player whose troop got First Blood wins. 


 6. Other rules have no change. You can find more details in game at description of Master Card Championship.


6.Game Balance Adjustment

 1. Skill [Holy Light Treatment] of hero “Light Knight / The Light” changes from healing 160 HP / 200 HP to healing 200 HP / 240 HP.


 2. Skill [Guided] of hero “Mechanist / Mech-Rex” changes from dealing 140 chaos damage to dealing 200 chaos damage.


 3. CD of skill [Meteor] of hero “Pit Fiend / Pit Lord” changes from 36 sec / 30 sec to 27 sec / 24 sec, and its effect changes from stunning 0.5 sec to stunning 1 sec.


 4. Attack Speed of troop “Naga II” changes from 1.4x/s to 1.3x/s, and its skill [Hunger] changs from healing 10% of max HP after 4 attacks to after 3 attacks.


 5. Cost of troop “Dervish” changes from 345 gold to 325 gold. 


 6. Cost of troop “Assassin” changes from 340 gold to 320 gold, and its attack changes from 78-82 to 88-83.


 7. Attack of troop “Manticore” changes from 74-88 to 54-68, its armor changes from 16 to 8, health changes from 880 to 1050, cost changes from 320 gold to 300 gold, its skill [Flourish] changes from healing 20 HP to healing 24 HP.
